title: FC Portfolio
tagline: Fc Portfolio is a frame that  fetches Farcaster user details via Pinata API  to create personalized portfolios.
description: Fc Portfolio is a frame that  fetches Farcaster user details via Pinata API  to create personalized portfolios. Track and manage online reputation for a farcaster account. Also get insights on other data points of a farcaster account. Analyze reputation score trends to enhance your online presence.
how_its_made: FC Portfolio is a dynamic frame crafted using @frames.js, leveraging the powerful capabilities of the Pinata Farcaster API to fetch detailed information about Farcaster users and construct personalized portfolios. The frame.js library streamlines the creation of modular UI components, ensuring a seamless and efficient development process. Through the integration of XMTP specifications, FC Portfolio adheres to standardized protocols, promoting interoperability and compatibility. Powered by Next.js and deployed on Vercel, FC Portfolio benefits from a robust and modern tech stack, enabling rapid iteration and deployment of updates while maintaining scalability and performance.
